NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Data Privacy and Protection Policy
 Document ID
NT-LEG-009
Department
Legal and Compliance
Version
2.2
Effective Date
01 February 2025
1. Purpose
This policy explains how NovaTech collects, uses, stores and protects personal data of customers
and employees, in line with India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.
2. Data Collection Principles
NovaTech collects only the personal data that is necessary for a stated purpose and obtains
consent before collection. Personal data is never sold to third parties.
3. Data Retention
Customer personal data is retained for 5 years after the end of the contract and then securely
deleted. Employee records are retained for 7 years after an employee leaves. Recruitment data of
unsuccessful candidates is deleted after 12 months. CCTV footage is stored for 30 days.
4. Data Subject Requests
Customers and employees can request access to, correction of, or deletion of their personal data
by writing to privacy@novatech.example. The Data Protection Officer responds to all requests
within 30 days.
5. Data Breach Response
If a personal data breach occurs, the Data Protection Officer must be informed within 24 hours of
discovery. Affected individuals and the Data Protection Board of India are notified within 72 hours
when the breach is likely to cause harm.
6. Third-Party Vendors
Vendors that process personal data on NovaTech's behalf must sign a Data Processing
Agreement and pass a security assessment before they are onboarded. Vendors are re-assessed
every 12 months.
Document Notice
Confidentiality Notice: This document is the property of NovaTech Solutions Pvt. Ltd. and is
intended for internal use by employees only. Unauthorised copying, sharing or distribution outside
the company is prohibited. For clarifications, contact the People and Culture team at
hr@novatech.example.
